According to Notice No. 12 of the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China (2020), our University makes the following supplementary provisions for accepting applications from international students for undergraduate study:(1) In accordance with the Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China, a person whose parents are both Chinese citizens and have settled abroad and who has acquired foreign nationality at birth shall not possess Chinese nationality. Applicants who apply for undergraduate study in our university as international students shall, in addition to meeting other registration qualifications of our university, hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for more than 4 years (inclusive), and have actually lived in a foreign country for at least 2 years in the last 4 years (as of April 30, 2025) (actually lived in a foreign country for at least 9 months in a year can be counted as one year). Subject to entry and exit signature).4.Be physically and mentally healthy, meet the physical examination requirements for applying for visa or residence permit in China, meet the physical examination requirements for applying for the major of our university, and ensure the normal study and life during my stay in China.5. No violation of discipline, no public security punishment, no criminal behavior and record, friendly to China, good conduct, abide by Chinese laws and school rules and regulations, respect the customs of the Chinese people.
